title: Nice table, but some flaws with the assembly
text: Nice table, but some flaws with the assembly. This wood table looks nice. I ran into a few problems during the assembly process though. Something that should have taken 10 minutes took me about 30 minutes as the holes were cut too deep for the screws. It would just take a second look from quality assurance to make sure everything was cut properly to prevent this type of problem from happening. It’s also a bit pricey for such a small piece. But it is real wood, which is a plus.
